运行前先预测关键输出，再对照断言和下方代码说明。核对通过后，尝试只改变一个输入或配置，解释输出为什么变化。

运行前的观察目标

首步 A 梯度范数为零，B 梯度通常非零；可训练参数数目为 14；冻结权重和 LoRA 合并检查通过。

python 33_finetuning_demo.py环境配置

从零实现 LoRA 并验证初始化与权重合并

33_finetuning_demo.py
import torchfrom torch import nnfrom torch.nn import functional as F torch.manual_seed(7)torch.set_num_threads(1) # STEP 1: 冻结原层，A 随机、B 为零class LoRALinear(nn.Module):    def __init__(self, in_dim, out_dim, rank=2, alpha=2.):        super().__init__()        self.base = nn.Linear(in_dim,out_dim)        self.base.requires_grad_(False)        self.A = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(rank,in_dim)*0.1)        self.B = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(out_dim,rank))        self.scale = alpha/rank    def forward(self,x):        return self.base(x) + self.scale*F.linear(F.linear(x,self.A),self.B) layer = LoRALinear(4,3)x = torch.randn(32,4)target = torch.randn(32,3)frozen_weight = layer.base.weight.detach().clone()torch.testing.assert_close(layer(x),layer.base(x)) # STEP 2: 检查第一步梯度，区分零梯度与没有梯度optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW([p for p in layer.parameters() if p.requires_grad],lr=0.03)loss = (layer(x)-target).square().mean()loss.backward()print('first A/B grad norms:', layer.A.grad.norm().item(), layer.B.grad.norm().item())assert layer.A.grad is not None and layer.B.grad is not Noneassert layer.base.weight.grad is Noneoptimizer.step() # STEP 3: 小型监督训练，只更新适配器for _ in range(60):    loss = (layer(x)-target).square().mean()    optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True)    loss.backward()    optimizer.step()torch.testing.assert_close(layer.base.weight, frozen_weight) # STEP 4: 合并后线性层应与适配器前向等价with torch.no_grad():    merged = layer.base.weight + layer.scale*(layer.B @ layer.A)    merged_output = F.linear(x,merged,layer.base.bias)    torch.testing.assert_close(merged_output,layer(x),atol=1e-6,rtol=1e-5)print('trainable parameters:', sum(p.numel() for p in layer.parameters() if p.requires_grad))print('frozen weight unchanged; merge check passed')
